company.name: Carlypso
company.shortDescription: Sell your car hassle-free. Get the money of a private sale with the convenience of a trade-in.
company.description:
More money, less effort.

Selling a used car is painful - you meet strangers during your free time, and then are frustrated when they make lowball offers. But if you trade it in, the dealer will offer you 40% less than the car is worth. Carlypso solves this problem - we take care of selling your car for you. You get the the money of a private sale with the convenience of a trade-in.
company.headquarters: South San Francisco, California, United States

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows car owners to sell their vehicles easily by combining the financial benefits of a private sale with the convenience of a trade-in process.
